ui_bugs.issue: Admin (role='admin') cannot access /davetiyelerim UI because the load() function checks md.user?.role !== 'member' and treats non-member users as logged-out (shows the member login form). Backend /api/invitations returns the admin's invitations (incl. 'Zeynep & Emre' 7348e22b-...) successfully, but UI blocks display of inv-venue-services-<id> button. This blocks admin-side testing of the couple marketplace VenueServicesModal.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/MyInvitations.jsx (line ~64) allow role in ['member','admin'] (or bypass role check when admin) so admin can access /davetiyelerim and open the VenueServicesModal for its owned invitations. Alternatively expose a dedicated admin route to reach the modal for testing.
critical_code_review_comments: FloorPlanBuilder timeline role toggle buttons (lines 215-220) have no data-testid; testing role selection requires text-based selectors. Add data-testid like tl-role-<itemId>-<roleKey> for robustness.
MyInvitations.jsx role gate ('!== "member"') hard-blocks admin/staff paths even when backend permits access; consider centralizing role gating.

rca of the issue: MyInvitations.jsx `load()` function requires user role to strictly equal 'member' — when admin logs in via /giris, the /api/member/me returns role='admin' so setMe(null) is called, rendering the InvitationLogin form instead of the invitation list. The inv-venue-services-<id> button is inside the invitation card which is never rendered for admin. Mitigation: relax the role check to include 'admin' or add a role-agnostic path when the /api/invitations endpoint successfully returns items.
